name: Bourtan
source:
Bourtan – is a character in Heralds of the Avirentes - Ch. 1 Wings of Change.
Bourtan is a young dark-grey blue-eyed om'verai, with 4 dark-blue horns, decorated by bracelets. One of Bourtan's horns is broken, each cheek has whiskers. Bourtan's belly plates are azure, so his back sharp-edged spikes, too.
Bourtan is a school bully and Naratyn is his favrite victim. Bourtan rarely attacks older people and has a quiet shy hidden personality.
